name: Alchemical Ink
source:
A tattoo artist that just happens to also be an Alchemist gets a last minute customer.
"Um, I really want that tattoo." She glanced at him from under pale lashes and folded her arms across her narrow chest. "Will you do it for sex?"
translation: 一位恰好也是炼金术师的纹身师接到了一位临时上门的客人。“嗯，我真的很想要那个纹身。”她从浅色的睫毛下瞥了他一眼，双臂交叉在纤细的胸前。“你愿意用性来交换吗？”
